keyword.keywordsPlaceholder: one per line or comma separated
keyword.keywordsHint: Whole words by default. word* matches a prefix, *word a suffix, *word* anywhere. Matching ignores case, accents, look-alike letters, spacing tricks and repeated letters.
keyword.regexHint: Up to 10, at most 260 characters each, case-insensitive. Back-references are not supported.
keyword.allowListHint: Words that never trigger this rule, e.g. a place name that contains a blocked word.

links.domainsHint: One per line. Subdomains are included.
